shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal band or register of repeated motifs across the upper part
rectilinear grid/net or ladder-like hatched motif
curved/nested line borders framing a field
justification: Both show shallow relief with a horizontal register of repeated units and some rectilinear hatched/grid patterning bounded by lines, which is the only real correspondence. A is purely abstract and geometric (two grid panels inside a nested-arc frame with no figures), while B is dominated by animal figures in profile — a quadruped, a crouching creature, a large bird with a curved beak — and a row of arch/loop signs, so the subject matter is fundamentally different.
